svg.text: AWS Reference Architecture — Event-Driven Orchestration with S3, SQS, Step Functions & CloudFront

g.text: S3 Raw • S3 Output • SQS • DynamoDB
VPC / SERVERLESS REGIONAL BACKBONE (HIGH AVAILABILITY MULTI-AZ)
Signs S3 PUT URL with 300s TTL
Direct client PUT bypasses compute layer
• Zero Server Maintenance: No EC2, ALB or NAT
• Direct Ingestion Speed: Wire-speed S3 bandwidth
• Attack Surface Isolation: Presigned URLs expire
• SQS decouples downstream Lambda concurrency spikes
• Poisoned messages quarantined without blocking queue
• DLQ Redrive utility enables safe manual inspection
Visual Workflow with Exponential Retries & Catch Blocks
Inspects file header magic bytes (PNG / JPEG / WebP) & ensures payload <= 15MB
Extracts EXIF, dimensions, color space, aspect ratio, and calculates MD5 checksum
Alpha-composite overlay with timestamp, copyright, and non-destructive transparency
Uploads generated thumbnails to Destination S3 bucket
Writes complete metadata record into DynamoDB ImageMetadata table
Publishes completion message with CloudFront URLs & metadata payload to SNS topic
Notifies downstream microservices, webhooks, and email subscribers
• Fully decoupled execution history in CloudWatch with step-by-step visual audit trail
• Automatic exponential backoff prevents transient S3 / DynamoDB throttle exceptions
• Operational Email Alerts to DevSecOps Team
